title: Tissue Sampling from Museum Specimens of Mitten Crabs
author: Christine Ewers
materials: Proceed to protocol: pH and formaldehyde measurement

steps.title: Document Specimen
steps.instruction: Extract a specimen from the collection jar and document it for traceability.

substeps.instruction: Open the collection jar and remove one specimen.
Place the specimen in a clean tray with a scale (e.g., ruler).

steps.title: Extract Tissue
steps.instruction: Collect tissue from one of the three possible extraction sites and place it in a 1.5ml Eppendorf tube.

substeps.instruction: If legs have already fallen off and are at the bottom of the jar, place the leg or a part of it in the tube.
Alternatively, use a scalpel to cut a small window (5x5mm) in the ventral side of a walking leg and remove muscle tissue using forceps.
Alternatively, use a scalpel to remove hair from 1/4 of one chela, using forceps to hold the hair.

steps.title: Preserve and Label Sample
steps.instruction: Finalize the sample tube and record the data in the spreadsheet.

substeps.instruction: Top off the Eppendorf tube with ethanol from the collection jar.
Label the tube with the collection code (e.g., ZMH) and a consecutive number (e.g., 01, 02, 03).
Enter collection information in the spreadsheet, ensuring the sampling ID (e.g., ZMH01) is linked to the collection ID (e.g., Cr24103).
